notice: Fictional local sample checkpoint only; no real Shopify activity or business metrics.

metrics.label: Members
metrics.definition: Verified enrolled accounts by period end.

metrics.label: Active earners
metrics.definition: Distinct customers with positive purchase earnings.

metrics.label: Gross earned points
metrics.definition: Positive purchase earning entries, before reversals.

metrics.label: Refund / edit reversals
metrics.definition: Absolute negative purchase refund/edit entries; separate from reward restoration.

metrics.label: Reward exchange debits
metrics.definition: Points spent when voucher issuance was confirmed.

metrics.label: Outstanding signed points
metrics.definition: Signed total; includes debt and already-held points. Not cash or a liability valuation.

metrics.label: Processing holds now
metrics.definition: Current snapshot, not a reconstructed historical hold balance; included within outstanding points.

metrics.label: Vouchers issued
metrics.definition: Confirmed voucher mappings; does not mean used.

metrics.label: Vouchers used
metrics.definition: Distinct vouchers with recorded paid usage; delayed webhooks can change this count.

metrics.label: Shopify discount amounts
metrics.definition: Gross observed reward discount allocation on paid orders before refund adjustments; not issued face value.

metrics.label: Repeat purchasers
metrics.definition: Customers with at least two non-cancelled orders retaining positive qualifying spend in period. No causal sales claim.

reconciliation.source: Local persisted ledger, reservations and voucher mappings
reconciliation.provider_verification: Not a live Shopify reconciliation or checkout test
